nodes.n: 3:20 AM. 2.4 million views. 3.1 million. The number moves faster than your heartbeat.

msgs.t: Bhaiya people are saying horrible things
Papa took the TV off the wall
I don't believe them. Just tell me it's fake.

nodes.th: It isn't fake. It just isn't true.

nodes.t: The integrity unit wants a statement by noon. Two sponsors want you off the list by one. I want to know one thing.
Did you take that man's money?
Handled. Good. Then handle my nets. Pads on.

nodes.n: He listens to all of it without blinking. The envelope, the hearing, the photo. When you finish, he clicks the stopwatch off.

nodes.t: Then you train. Let the lawyers talk. Nets in ten.

nodes.n: Lunch hall. A table of six goes quiet when you sit down. Then five of them stand up and leave.

msgs.t: Saw the video. Doesn't change anything.
Still angry with you about the shin though.

nodes.t: Sorry in advance. I'm sitting here. Also I'm eating your dal.

msgs.t: Agencies protect their people. Just saying. 🙂

nodes.t: Smile. Chin up. We release a charity cheque at six, the shoe ad at eight, and by tomorrow nobody remembers a hotel lobby.
This is what you pay me for, {first}. Trust the process.

nodes.th: Noon. They want words. Which words?

choice.t: Post the truth yourself. Every detail.

choice.d: She'll ask the hard questions. Fairly.

choice.t: Say nothing. Let the bat answer.
Hire a forensic expert to prove the clip was cut.

nodes.n: You post nothing. The trolls get louder for a day. Then a cat video goes viral and the internet moves on. Mostly.
Four hundred words. No lawyer, no agency. By evening the comments split down the middle. Half of India believes you. That's more than yesterday.
Neha's interview goes up at 9 PM. She doesn't go easy on you. That's exactly why people believe it.
The expert's report is out by 6 PM: the clip was edited. Three seconds of you walking away were cut out. The story flips. Now people want to know who cut it.
11:48 PM. A call from a number with no caller ID.

nodes.t: Mr. {first}. Raghav Mehra. Forgive the hour. Men like me don't sleep much.
I can make that clip disappear from every phone in India by sunrise. I own more of the internet than you'd think.
Or I can release the other one. The one with sound.

nodes.cliff: There's a second video. And Raghav Mehra wants something for it.
